purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of operational drought, landslide and severe-convective hazard monitoring services relevant to catastrophe risk.

entries.name: Copernicus Global and European Drought Observatory WMS/WCS services
entries.provider: Copernicus Emergency Management Service / European Commission Joint Research Centre
entries.spatial_scope: global and European products depending on indicator
entries.temporal_scope: operational indicators with indicator-specific archives and update cadences
entries.resolution_or_granularity: WMS map layers and WCS coverages for indicators including SPI, soil-moisture anomalies, GRACE TWS anomalies, forecasts and drought-impact indicators; WCS supports GeoTIFF output
entries.note: The current CEMS drought service documents WCS GetCoverage/DescribeCoverage and a companion WMS service for GDO/EDO indicators. Do not collapse different indicator families or versions into one variable: freeze coverage/layer ID, selected timescale, date, CRS, processing version and whether a field is observed, reanalysis-derived, forecast or composite.

entries.name: NASA Landslide Hazard Nowcast and Exposure (LHASA) 2.1
entries.provider: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / NASA Earthdata
entries.spatial_scope: global land coverage approximately 56°S to 84°N in the current exposure service
entries.temporal_scope: April 2021-present; current overview states twice-daily updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: approximately 30 arcseconds (~1 km) hazard nowcast plus administrative exposure summaries; ArcGIS feature service supports JSON, GeoJSON and PBF
entries.note: LHASA 2.1 combines GPM precipitation with SMAP antecedent soil moisture and machine learning, and the current NASA service includes exposure summaries. It is a global situational-awareness nowcast rather than local slope-stability truth; preserve model version, valid time, upstream product lineage, hazard field, administrative geometry and exposure semantics.

entries.name: NOAA Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor System (MRMS) operational products
entries.provider: NOAA National Severe Storms Laboratory / National Weather Service
entries.spatial_scope: United States operational MRMS domains; product/domain dependent
entries.temporal_scope: operational real-time service plus product-specific archives
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GRIB2 multi-radar/multi-sensor grids; current operational tables include 2-minute MESH and multiple hail-swath accumulations alongside precipitation and other severe-weather products
entries.note: NOAA documents real-time operational MRMS delivery by HTTP/LDM in GRIB2, while product tables define fields such as Maximum Estimated Size of Hail (MESH). MESH is radar/model-derived estimated hail size, not direct ground truth; preserve MRMS version, domain, product code, units, cadence, valid time, QC state and any archive/reanalysis distinction.
